note: exploration after stage 1 on the development folds (evaluation 2023 and 2024), no refit; choices made here are a selection on these folds, and a final check needs its own pre-registration; calibration and holdout were not read
policy: rolling list with release, at most K open (window = horizon)

combinations.rank_mean F2+list: mean of the within-day ranks of F2 and the static list
combinations.rank_mean F2+sel+list: mean of the within-day ranks of F2+sel and the static list
combinations.list, ties by F2: static list; ties inside one event count ordered by F2

calibration_rule: bins of consecutive counts with n >= 30 (requested) and n >= 100 (coarse, added) in the build year, Wilson 95%; Wilson assumes independent cards, but cards of one pair repeat, so the intervals are optimistic
